title: dungeoncraft-r
description: DungeonCraft is a modpack that brings the Minecraft Dungeons experience into Minecraft with new camera, dungeons, animations, and bosses.
body:
**⚔️ DungeonCraft**

Bring the thrilling action of Minecraft Dungeons into Java Edition!

DungeonCraft is a meticulously crafted Minecraft modpack designed to recreate the distinct atmosphere, fast-paced combat, and visual style of Minecraft Dungeons. If you've ever wanted to experience blocky ARPG-style hack-and-slash gameplay directly inside regular Minecraft, this pack is built just for you.

✨ Key Features & Gameplay

🎥 Isometric Perspective: Play from a unique top-down camera angle that completely changes how you navigate and fight, perfectly mimicking the Minecraft Dungeons experience.

⚔️ Overhauled Combat: Forget vanilla spam-clicking. Enjoy fluid, updated combat animations and tactical encounters that make every battle feel impactful.

👹 Dangerous Foes & Epic Bosses: Face off against improved mobs, smarter AI, and powerful new bosses waiting for you in the depths.

🏰 Enhanced Dungeon Generation: Explore massive, beautifully generated dungeons packed with loot, secrets, and challenges.

🎨 True-to-Game Visuals: Features custom main menus, enhanced textures, and fully animated entities that breathe life into the world.

📦 Content Breakdown

DungeonCraft achieves its seamless atmosphere by carefully balancing performance and content without bloating your game:

49 Hand-Picked Mods focusing on gameplay mechanics, camera control, and atmosphere.

23 Resource Packs working together to deliver that authentic, vibrant look.

🛠️ Important: Resource Pack Loading Order

To ensure animations and textures display correctly, please arrange your resource packs in the following order in your settings:

🔝 Fresh Animations: Extensions

🔸 Fresh Animations

🔹 Dungeons Hotbar

🔽 All other included resource packs below

📝 Notes & Future Plans

**⚠️ Note on Lore: This modpack focuses entirely on recreating the gameplay, combat, and visual atmosphere of Minecraft Dungeons. The original story/campaign is not included.**



**What's Next? I am planning to implement custom accessories and cosmetic 3D items using the Figura mod in future updates.**
